nom: Peach Slices Oil Control Balancing Cleanser

avis.texte: A little bit goes a long way! The scent is so refreshing and pleasant. I pair it with the moisturizer and the mattifying spray. Great product!!!

This cleanser has made such a difference in the amount of oil in my skin. It has also helped to clear my skin from acne and lightened dark spots. Before I found this, when I would wash my face in the morning, it became oily & shiny almost immediately, and now it so much less oily, and I love that it has niacinimide and botanical extracts in it. It is so good for my skin! It has so many natural ingredients and it's been so good to my skin! I have been using this for about a year now, and I can't live without it!

Wow, this facial cleanser makes such a huge difference in my skin and oil production throughout the day. I pair it with the Oil Co trol Daily Moisturizer and my face stays smooth and hydrated but not oily and overly shiny.

This cleanser seemed great the first time I used it, and my skin initially felt tightet and cleaner, however I woke up the next day with painful acne on areas of my face it doesn't normally appear. The more I used it, my skin became more oily in the T-zone, more painful acne appeared and sebum/blackheads multiplied. It also left what are almost burn marks of redness from irritation. I'll be returning to my gentle 2% salicylic acud cleanser with no added oils, fragrances or ingredients. I don't reccomend this to anyone.
My face has not been as oily during the day since I started using this. It smells amazing. It doesn't dry out my face either. It's perfect.
Works great, I noticed a difference on my oily skin after I started using this product.
I have super oily skin so I'm always looking at ways to improve this issue. This cleanser has been great at helping me reduce how much oil I produce in a day or decrease it greatly. Highly recommend.

I ordered this oil control cleanser for my spouse because he struggles with oily skin and nothing has ever kept it balanced all day, until he tried this one. This is the first time he's actually had luck with a product keeping his skin even and not leaving him so dry that his body overcompensates and produces too much oil later in the day. He loves it and I am really excited that it works for him.
Nice non-abrasive cleanser with a cool sensation. A little goes a long way :)
I have always struggled with oily skin and i gave this product a try. omg! It works so well, it doesnt dry yout skin at all and way less breakouts. im almost 40 and this is a must. Love !!
It worked wonders for my skin so I definitely had to order again!

avis.titre: helped control oil, but also broke me out
avis.texte: it did help control oil, but in the same concern areas i got really bad painful breakouts too.
The entire Peach Slices oil control line has dramatically improved my makeup game and folliculitis wellness. They're great products and are really affordable.

Bought this cleanser for my daughter to try. She loves this how clean her face feels after washing. We can definitely see an improvement in the redness and excess oil. Smells like mint, very light scent.

avis.titre: Works Great for My Oily Skin!
avis.texte: I've been battling oily skin for almost my whole life. Not acne prone but i have been known to skip washing my face once or twice—which leads to blackheads and pimples 😔. This cleanser does absorb the oil and helps me not be so obviosuly "shiny" throughout the day. I use the moisturizer and serum as well! Worth the price!
The older I get told her you're my face gets. I love this product!
Perfect face wash that is gentle but controls oil without drying me out.

I bought this because it shared similar ingredients to another face cleanser I've been using for the past year that's being discontinued. However, while the Peach Slices cleanser smells nice and does shrink my pores a bit, I've also noticed that my t-zone has become oilier and I've been getting blind pimples more frequently.
I love this cleanser. I combination to oily skin. Specifically in my t-zone but I have noticed over time it has become more manageable.
Doesn't help with oil control as much as I expected, was hoping that it would.
Bought this for my daughter and she said it was the best so I decided to try it and I love it

avis.titre: Broke my skin out with painful acne
avis.texte: My face is genrally combo skin with sime acne, but its normally just a few zits here and there as I've kept it under control. This product made me break out immediately all over my face with painful cystic acne and small whitehead acne. Transported me back to awful puberty skin! Im disappointed because the ingredients list seems like it would be good for acne but this made it worse. I'll be returning.

I have very oily skin and large pores. I've tried everything under the sun to balance my oily skin and most products just dry me out. This cleanser leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed. Does not dry me out at all. It also does help balance out my oiliness.

I am always so impressed with anything from their Peach Slices line. This cleanser is amazing. It lathers nicely and washes off quickly. It leaves my skin clean but not dry. I don't usually like gel cleansers in a squeeze tube because I find that it leaks and gets messy but this gel is a bit more viscous than the ones I've used. Does it control oil? I would say yes. My face usually needs a wipe down about 7 hours into my day but with this cleanser and the toner from the same line; I can last 10 hours into my shift without turning into a greaseball. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Best Face Wash for Combo Skin
avis.texte: This face wash is fantastic! It took me a very long time to locate the perfect face cleanser because of my combination skin type. Some cleansers were too oily or too dry for my skin. So I had to speak with a skin care specialist at Ulta about my concerns, and when she recommended this face wash, I haven't gone back. When I use the face wash, my blackheads and the large red spots under my nose that were difficult for makeup to cover up completely disappeared. After washing my face, I also adore the recipe since it feels so fresh and comfortable on my skin. Thus, to everyone who has combination skin should use this cleanser.
It smells like mint, no breakouts and oiliness sensation on the skin
I was skeptical at first, usually I buy tea tree oil face products… but from now on this will be my go to!
I have been dealing with acne for almost 20 years now. Nothing works! I have even done very expensive laser treatments with not results. THIS HAS SAVED MY SKIN!!!

avis.texte: i have very oily skin and this always soaks up any oil on my face and gives me a non greasy glow! i love this cleanser
I love this stuff! I combined it with the serum and moisturizer. Little to no scent for my sensitive skin.. don't over dry and takes away my extra oily skin.

avis.titre: Most effective product to control my oils
avis.texte: I've tried many oil control products as someone with extremely oily skin, and this is by far the product I've seen the most impact with. I used to be so oily I'd start to sweat off my makeup as I was applying it, but now my oils are under control! Has become an essential in my skincare routine.

I struggle w/ very oily skin & r always looking for a face wash that can handle that!! This one can & its very gentle at the same time. It smells wonderful w/out! the use of fragrance. It uses clean ingredients which i love & will continue to buy!!

I love peach slices, but this cleanser wasn't for me. I have oily skin; at first, it did work and I felt so fresh all day! But then it started drying out my skin to the point it was stinging and peeling. Maybe it's a better fit for someone else
Great cleanser for oily skin, makes my skin feel clean and not stripped.

Not so sure about the oil reduction, as I only used it twice (and didn't notice any differences), but I'm quite sensitive to most cleansers, and this one did well with my skin. Provides a good clean, and has a nice, subtle scent. The size is also quite large and generous!
Love this cleanser. I use it for my face cleanser both AM and PM
I tried this from start to finish and it is a pretty decent cleanser the con for me it is it does burn my eyes pretty bad when it touches that area

This cleanser WHEW cleans my skin like no other. I can feel it working deep in my pores with every use. What is even more exciting is seeing results!! I recommend the entire oil control line to all my oily beauties. Trust me it'll change your life!!
This has me sooooo dry and itchy. My skin is oily but also sensitive in some areas. This product is not great for me.
Perfect for everyday cleansing. Gentle enough for my skin but powerful enough to help with all the oil. Excellent product!

I haven't purchased anything from this brand that i haven't loved. This cleanser is new to me so I need to use it more to determine if i would buy this exact one again. I had been using the red rescue (green tube) one which is amazing.
Dsikt facial cleanser. No residue . Face feels refreshing after use

avis.titre: This one didn't work out for me:(
avis.texte: I tried this one, but unfortunately it didn't work out for my skin. I loved other sets in the peach slices and was hoping that this one would too.
I have really oily skin and wanted to try out this line. The cleanser is nice and has a clean smell to it. I think my skin really likes this so will most likely repurchase.

I love this cleanser!! Really helps my oliy skin and doesnt irritate my skin. Also helps with my acne! The only down fall to this cleanser is it does have a hint smell of chlorine. But its not too strong where i cant stand the cleanser.

I've been using this cleanser for a little over a week now, it's been such a game changer! I have combo oily skin and by the end of the day I'm usually a shiny mess. I use this every morning before my makeup and it has helped significantly in reducing how oily my face gets. It feels gentle, has a pleasant spa-like scent, and foams up nicely.
I am begging companies to stop putting tea tree and eucalyptus in products for oily skin. The irritation they cause seems to just make my skin oilier

I have oily/acne prone skin and I just picked up this cleanser a few days ago. So far I'm loving it! I feel like i get a deep clean without my skin feeling stripped afterwards. I would watch out if you are sensitive to fragrance b/c this does contain eucalyptus but it is very faint and the scent goes way almost instantly. Yet another great product from peach slices! Can't wait to try out the rest of the Oil Control line!
I used this cleanser daily, sometimes pairing it with an exfoliant. Easy to wash off, no dry feeling.
